scope.definition: Repository-native, governed conversion of agent/user/CI/runtime evidence into reviewed postmortems, versioned evaluation cases, and minimal prompt/workflow/tool/code proposals; then offline replay, non-authoritative shadowing, bounded canary, promotion or rollback.
in_scope: independent promotion policy, canary, rollback and audit
drift reconciliation between Git declarations and GitHub remote state
out_of_scope: autonomous product intent or roadmap choice
an agent approving its own grader, permissions, policy, release, or audit mutation
claim that repository files themselves are actual GitHub Project or deployment state
scope.boundary: The agent is a proposer and bounded experiment subject. A separately owned evaluator, policy authority and deployment identity decide. High-impact or irreversible changes remain human-authorized.

current_capabilities.verified: GraphQL exposes ProjectV2 objects and mutations including updateProjectV2ItemFieldValue; GitHub documents API automation and projects_v2_item webhooks. Git YAML is not the service database: field/option/item node IDs and current values live remotely (https://docs.github.com/en/issues/planning-and-tracking-with-projects/automating-your-project/using-the-api-to-manage-projects; https://docs.github.com/en/graphql/reference/mutations#updateprojectv2itemfieldvalue; https://docs.github.com/en/webhooks/webhook-events-and-payloads#projects-v2-item).
current_capabilities.limit: A commit only states desired state. A credentialed reconciler must read, diff, mutate and verify remote state; webhooks can be missed/duplicated, so scheduled full scans remain necessary.

current_capabilities.verified: CODEOWNERS can require review of protected paths; repository/organization rulesets expose enforcement and bypass controls; Actions environments can require reviewers, prevent self-review, gate secrets, and delay jobs (https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/managing-your-repositorys-settings-and-features/customizing-your-repository/about-code-owners; https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/rules; https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/deployments-and-environments).
current_capabilities.limit: These features must be configured in GitHub remote settings. CODEOWNERS alone does not enforce review. Environment reviewer semantics and availability vary by plan/repository; only one of up to six listed reviewers must approve, so use a team/process or external policy when two-person approval is required.

current_capabilities.verified: Workflow/job permissions can reduce GITHUB_TOKEN scopes, reusable workflows centralize typed inputs/secrets, secure-use guidance recommends full-SHA pinning, and artifact attestations add verifiable provenance (https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/workflow-syntax#permissions; https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/reusing-workflow-configurations; https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/security/secure-use; https://docs.github.com/en/actions/concepts/security/artifact-attestations).
current_capabilities.limit: A reusable workflow is not a trust boundary if it checks out and runs attacker-controlled code with write tokens/secrets. Third-party actions and mutable tool/model endpoints remain dependencies.

current_capabilities.verified: OpenTelemetry provides portable traces/metrics/logs; OpenAI and Anthropic document representative datasets, continuous evaluation, trajectory/outcome grading, repeated trials and human calibration (https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/otel/overview/; https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/evaluation-best-practices; https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/demystifying-evals-for-ai-agents).
current_capabilities.limit: GenAI/agent schemas and graders are evolving. Vendor guidance demonstrates a method, not independent outcome validity.

current_capabilities.verified: Argo Rollouts can pause, promote or abort canaries from metric analysis; Google SRE describes control/canary comparison and rollback discipline (https://argo-rollouts.readthedocs.io/en/stable/features/analysis/; https://sre.google/workbook/canarying-releases/).
current_capabilities.limit: Rare, delayed, tenant-specific and irreversible effects can escape a canary. Inconclusive evidence must pause, not auto-pass.

representative_systems.role: version and review declarations, run evidence-producing jobs, require independent deployment approval
materialized operational view; never confused with desired YAML in Git
correlate run→feedback→case and compare candidate/current on frozen and fresh slices

systems: Argo Rollouts or equivalent feature-flag controller
Google SRE postmortems, SLOs and error budgets
representative_systems.role: blameless causal learning, owned actions, monitoring/incident/recourse governance
test leakage, prompt-injection control failure, productivity optimism and monocausal postmortems

primary_evidence.claim: GitHub Project fields/items are remote GraphQL resources changed by mutations; project item events are webhook inputs, not a Git-native state store.
primary_evidence.design_consequence: Keep desired schema/mappings in Git, observed snapshots in artifacts/audit storage, and reconcile by stable logical keys plus resolved node IDs.

primary_evidence.claim: GitHub supplies protected review/deployment and least-privilege workflow mechanisms.
primary_evidence.design_consequence: Protect policy/eval/workflow paths and use a separate deployment identity/environment; deny proposer self-review and ruleset bypass.

primary_evidence.claim: Eval practice calls for representative data, continuous evaluation, explicit task/success definitions, trajectory/outcome inspection, regression suites and human calibration.
primary_evidence.design_consequence: Every promoted control version carries dataset/harness/grader hashes, repeated-trial slice results and human adjudication for ambiguous/high-risk cases.

primary_evidence.claim: Mature SRE practice connects incident evidence to blameless postmortems, owned preventive actions, SLO/error-budget decisions and controlled canaries.
primary_evidence.design_consequence: Failures and rollbacks create reviewed eval candidates and actions, never automatic training data.

primary_evidence.claim: NIST AI 600-1 recommends pre-deployment testing, ongoing monitoring/review, incident handling, provenance and feedback/recourse; NIST SP 800-204C describes policy-as-code CI/CD and conflict/update checks.
primary_evidence.design_consequence: Treat eval/policy/data lineage and appeals as governed lifecycle records, not model-local memory.

primary_evidence.claim: SLSA provenance binds an artifact to build inputs/process; GitHub artifact attestations implement provenance evidence.
primary_evidence.design_consequence: Promote immutable prompt/tool/workflow bundles by digest, never a mutable branch/tag alone.

independent_evidence.finding: SWE-Bench+ reported 32.67% solution leakage, 31.08% suspicious passes due to weak tests, and resolution falling 12.47%→3.97% after filtering.
independent_evidence.implication: A benchmark pass is not ground truth; isolate hidden/private temporal holdouts, audit tests and preserve fresh production cases.

independent_evidence.finding: AgentDojo evaluates prompt-injection attacks in tool-using agents and found attacks/defenses materially trade off utility and security; no benchmark proves general prompt-injection immunity.
independent_evidence.implication: Treat telemetry, issues, PR text and tool output as hostile data; do not expose promotion credentials or policy writes to the evaluated agent.

independent_evidence.finding: GitHub Security Lab explains pwn-request risks when privileged workflow_run jobs consume artifacts/code from untrusted pull requests.
independent_evidence.implication: Split untrusted candidate execution from privileged promotion; validate artifact identity/content and never execute PR scripts after privilege elevation.

independent_evidence.finding: METR’s randomized study of experienced open-source developers reported AI tools made assigned tasks 19% slower while participants had expected 24% faster and still believed afterward they were 20% faster.
independent_evidence.implication: Baseline local cycle time and retained outcome; do not promote from subjective speed or benchmark rank.

independent_evidence.finding: Cook warns complex-system failures have multiple contributing conditions and that hindsight overstates a single root cause.
independent_evidence.implication: Postmortems must capture failed defenses and interacting changes rather than auto-label one causal prompt/tool.

independent_evidence.finding: SPACE rejects a single developer-productivity metric across satisfaction, performance, activity, communication and efficiency.
independent_evidence.implication: Pair speed/cost with quality, stability, security, human load and user outcomes to resist metric gaming.

promotion_scorecard: task success and invariant pass by declared risk/slice with trial count and confidence interval
near-100% regression reliability for mature must-pass cases; any critical safety/authorization violation is a hard fail
escaped-defect, rollback, unsafe-action and policy-violation rate
user/SLO outcome, change-failure and recurrence rate over a declared delayed-outcome window
grader-to-blinded-expert agreement and disagreement by slice
dataset age, provenance coverage, deduplication/contamination findings
shadow divergence and attempted side effects; canary exposure, abort, inconclusive and rollback latency
exact_known_limits: GitHub environment protection can list up to six required reviewers and only one listed reviewer must approve; prevent-self-review is configurable (https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/deployments-and-environments).

Anthropic illustrates stochastic compounding: at 75% per-trial success, three consecutive successes occur about 42% of the time; report pass@1/pass@k/pass^k rather than one run (https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/demystifying-evals-for-ai-agents).
SWE-Bench+ 12.47%→3.97% after filtering quantifies one benchmark’s oracle/leakage risk, not a universal correction factor (https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.06992).

METR’s 19% slowdown is for 16 experienced developers, 246 tasks and the studied early-2025 tools; it is not a universal productivity estimate (https://metr.org/blog/2025-07-10-early-2025-ai-experienced-os-dev-study/).
metrics_and_limits.no_universal_threshold: Power, minimum detectable effect, observation window, non-inferiority margin and risk threshold must be predeclared per task class. Low event counts and rare harms make many canaries inconclusive. Never auto-promote an inconclusive result or optimize one composite score.

recommended_design.name: Separated evidence-to-change controller with Git-desired/remote-actual reconciliation

planes.runtime: Agent runs with read and task-branch proposal rights only; emits versioned evidence.
planes.evidence: Append-only restricted store indexes redacted OTel envelopes and immutable artifacts; Git records references/hashes, not secrets or raw PII.
planes.learning: Curators turn reviewed failures/successes into fixtures. Hidden holdouts and grader configuration are invisible/read-only to proposer.
planes.change: A PR contains one hypothesis and minimal prompt/workflow/tool/code delta plus rollback handle.
planes.governance: Independent GitHub App/workflow evaluates policy; protected environment/human gate promotes immutable digests; a separate controller can abort/restore last-known-good.

recommended_design.project_status_model: Git owns desired field names/options, transition policy and logical mappings. GitHub Projects owns actual item/field/node IDs and live status. Reconciler reads actual, produces a drift plan, mutates only explicitly managed fields, re-reads to verify, records observed revision/hash and opens drift issues for destructive/ambiguous differences. Human-owned/unmanaged fields are report-only.
identity_separation: proposer: issues read, branch/PR write; no Actions secrets, project-policy mutation, holdout, deploy or audit-delete
evaluator: read candidate and hidden tests; write signed report only; no proposal mutation or deployment
reconciler: narrow Projects/Issues write for allowlisted org/project/fields; no repository contents or deploy
promoter/rollback controller: read signed evidence and protected policy; environment/deploy rights only; no candidate authoring
human policy owners/break-glass: protected approval, expiry and audit; hardware/SSO-backed where possible
recommended_design.default_decision: Fail closed on identity, digest, provenance, policy or safety-invariant failure. Pause on missing, stale, conflicting or underpowered evidence. Roll back automatically only to a tested compatible digest with reversible side effects.

state_and_event_contract.allowed_flow: OBSERVED→TRIAGED→(POSTMORTEM_REQUIRED)→CURATION_PENDING→EVAL_REVIEW→EVAL_APPROVED→PROPOSED→OFFLINE_RUNNING→OFFLINE_PASSED→SHADOW_RUNNING→CANARY_PENDING_APPROVAL→CANARY_RUNNING→PROMOTED→CLOSED. Any check can go to FAILED/REJECTED; shadow/canary/late outcome can go to ROLLED_BACK then OBSERVED with a new case. Skipping a stage requires a signed, expiring exception; policy/permission/evaluator changes cannot skip human approval.

event_envelope.subject: case/proposal/release id
event_envelope.risk_and_scope: risk tier, allowed actions, cohort, spend/time/traffic limits
event_envelope.decision: policy result, rule version, approver identities, reason and expiry

state_and_event_contract.idempotency: Persist unique (event_id) and (subject, transition, candidate_digest, policy_version). Duplicate delivery returns prior result. Consumers checkpoint after durable side effect. Every external mutation uses a deterministic marker/clientMutationId where supported and verifies by re-read.
state_and_event_contract.ordering_and_concurrency: Reject stale head/dataset/policy digests. Serialize per subject with a lease or compare observed revision/hash before mutation. Out-of-order events are stored then replayed; impossible transitions open an exception, never infer success.
state_and_event_contract.reconciliation: Webhook gives fast hints; scheduled full scan is authoritative recovery. Resolve logical Project field/option names to current node IDs each run, compare desired/actual, classify additive/safe, conflicting, destructive or unmanaged drift, plan before apply, mutate allowlisted managed fields only, re-query, and audit before/after. Destructive option deletion/rename or human-edited conflict requires review.

files.purpose: JSON Schema for repository/risk/project/improvement configuration
enabled task classes, logical Project reference, managed fields, SLOs, budgets and external evidence-store references
desired logical fields/options/views/mappings and ownership mode managed|observe; never claimed as actual remote state
schema for generated observed revision, node-ID map, drift and last verified time; snapshots stored as CI artifacts/audit records, not blindly committed
state/event envelope validation
feedback consent, provenance, severity and trace link
hypothesis, change class, digests, metrics, thresholds, exposure and rollback
fixture reference, oracle/invariants, provenance/privacy, slices and split
versioned public/regression case manifests and content hashes; private holdout only by opaque ID/hash
impact, timeline, contributors/failed defenses, mitigation, evidence, owned actions and eval candidates
deny/pause/approve rules tested and owned independently
immutable component digests, compatibility, previous digest and kill/rollback handle
independent owners for workflows, policy, schemas and eval manifests
validate/redact/link events without executing untrusted payload
reusable hermetic repeated evaluation with read-only tokens
plan/apply remote Project drift using narrow GitHub App identity
live mirror with tools forced to no-side-effect adapters
protected-environment deployment of signed digest and analysis
restore approved compatible last-known-good and verify
contract, property, negative security, replay and drill tests
owned failure procedures and escalation

repository_artifacts.protection: Ruleset + CODEOWNERS require independent review of all control files. Workflows/actions are pinned to full commit SHA; generated evidence is attested and retained externally. Raw telemetry, secrets, holdouts, credentials and mutable actual Project snapshots do not enter ordinary Git history.

workflow_steps.input: user feedback, review edits, CI/security/dependency event, rollback, trace/SLO signal or sampled success
workflow_steps.action: Normalize and deduplicate. Correlate trace/change IDs and exact component digests. DLP/redact before storage; quarantine untrusted text.
workflow_steps.stop: drop/aggregate unauthorized, duplicate or unverifiable input; page incident path for active harm.

workflow_steps.action: Classify risk/privacy/severity, reproduce where safe, assign owner/SLA, and compare with SLO/error budget.
workflow_steps.stop: ambiguous intent, security/privacy impact or exhausted error budget requires human.

workflow_steps.action: Write blameless multi-factor postmortem. Minimize/de-identify reproduced case; record licensing/consent/provenance; independently label and time-split holdout.
workflow_steps.output: reviewed postmortem, owned actions, eval candidate
workflow_steps.stop: no verified oracle, consent/provenance failure, secret/PII leakage or unresolved label disagreement.

workflow_steps.action: Curator checks expected invariants, counterexamples, split/leakage and rubric; separate public capability from near-100% regression suite.
workflow_steps.stop: proposer cannot approve inclusion or see hidden expected results.

workflow_steps.action: Agent opens a small PR changing one prompt/router/tool/workflow/code component with hypothesis, affected classes, expected value, risk, budgets, thresholds and compatible rollback digest.
workflow_steps.stop: reject bundled permission/policy/hidden-eval/audit changes or missing rollback.

workflow_steps.input: immutable candidate SHA and frozen dataset/policy
workflow_steps.action: Use clean sandbox; deterministic tests/scans, repeated stochastic trials, public+private temporal holdouts, adversarial/metamorphic slices, cost/latency, expert-calibrated grading; attest raw results.
workflow_steps.stop: any critical invariant/authorization failure; stale/missing digest; material regression; insufficient evidence pauses.

workflow_steps.action: Independent policy engine evaluates risk, provenance, thresholds, error budget, reviewer and rollback drill. GitHub protected paths/environment bind approval to exact SHA/digests.
workflow_steps.stop: agent author/committer cannot satisfy independent gate; sensitive classes require named human owner.

workflow_steps.action: Mirror representative live inputs with zero-authority tool adapters; compare decision/trajectory, safety, cost and latency against control; label all candidate outputs non-operative.
workflow_steps.stop: attempted side effect, data-policy breach, divergence/safety threshold failure or inconclusive window.

workflow_steps.action: Deploy signed digest to smallest representative cohort with concurrent control, fixed max traffic/time/actions/spend/error burn, automated abort and manual kill switch.
workflow_steps.stop: predeclared fail threshold aborts; inconclusive pauses; rollback failure becomes incident.

workflow_steps.action: Atomically point registry to immutable digest, preserve previous; observe delayed/segmented outcome and re-read deployment/Project actual state.
workflow_steps.output: retained release or rollback, linked audit chain
workflow_steps.stop: late regression restores last-known-good and opens new case; never silently edit evidence.

workflow_steps.action: Reconcile Git-desired config with GitHub Project/rules/environment actual state; review recurrence, drift, action age, evaluator agreement, sampling and exception expiry monthly.
workflow_steps.output: verified actual snapshot, drift plan/issues, control improvements
workflow_steps.stop: destructive/ambiguous/unmanaged drift is report-only until human approval.

human_gates.required_when: new product behavior, ambiguous report, new rubric/oracle, high label/grader disagreement, protected-class or legal/privacy impact
human_gates.binding: named owner approves exact case/rubric/dataset digest; approval invalid after digest change

human_gates.required_when: policy, grader/evaluator, hidden-test inclusion rule, permissions, secrets, identity, workflow trust, retention/audit, ruleset/CODEOWNERS/environment or Project schema/destructive drift
human_gates.binding: independent CODEOWNER/ruleset plus protected environment; proposer cannot count; exact head SHA and policy/evidence digests recorded

human_gates.required_when: security/IAM, destructive or irreversible side effect, schema/data migration, production incident repair, public API/legal/safety behavior, large blast radius or exhausted error budget
human_gates.binding: domain owner and accountable release/incident owner approve bounded exposure and compensation plan; two-person confirmation where feasible

human_gates.required_when: underpowered/conflicting metrics, failed check override, rollback incompatibility, expired evidence or emergency bypass
human_gates.binding: record failed rule/hashes, reason, owner, scope, compensating controls, start/expiry, rollback/kill switch, approvers and follow-up case; never convert inconclusive to pass

human_gates.required_when: material incident, user appeal, rollback/on-call action or repeated failure
human_gates.binding: review postmortem, eval inclusion and action closure; an agent may draft but not close its own governance action

security_and_failure_modes.attack_or_fault: agent edits grader, holdout, threshold, CODEOWNERS/ruleset, permissions or audit, then declares success
security_and_failure_modes.mitigation: separate identities/stores; deny proposer writes; remote rulesets/environments; protected branches; independent attestation/policy; human gate for all controller changes

security_and_failure_modes.attack_or_fault: issue, trace, PR, comment or tool output instructs agent/evaluator to leak secrets or weaken policy
security_and_failure_modes.mitigation: treat content as data, structured parsers, no credentials in evaluated context, allowlisted tools/egress, DLP/quarantine, AgentDojo-style injection tests (https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.13352)

security_and_failure_modes.attack_or_fault: workflow_run or privileged job downloads artifact/checks out untrusted PR and executes it
security_and_failure_modes.mitigation: untrusted job has permissions:{contents:read}; privileged job never executes candidate, validates run/repo/SHA/digest/schema/size and attestation, uses approved interpreter; follow GitHub Security Lab pwn-request guidance (https://securitylab.github.com/resources/github-actions-preventing-pwn-requests/)

security_and_failure_modes.attack_or_fault: mutable action tag, tool image, model alias or artifact changes between eval and deploy
security_and_failure_modes.mitigation: full-SHA action pins, image/model/prompt/tool digests, lockfiles, SLSA/GitHub attestation, signature verification and exact-digest environment approval

security_and_failure_modes.attack_or_fault: weak tests, visible oracle, repeated tuning or LLM judge preference inflates score
security_and_failure_modes.mitigation: private temporal holdout, proposer/evaluator separation, deterministic invariants, blinded expert calibration, multiple graders/trials, contamination and suspicious-pass audit (https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.06992)

security_and_failure_modes.attack_or_fault: prompts/traces contain PII, secrets, proprietary code or hostile payload; deletion does not propagate
security_and_failure_modes.mitigation: data minimization, SDK+collector redaction, opaque object references, consent/license/retention tags, tiered access, lineage-aware delete and access audit (https://opentelemetry.io/docs/security/handling-sensitive-data/)

security_and_failure_modes.attack_or_fault: small biased cohort misses rare/delayed harm or overlapping releases confound cause
security_and_failure_modes.mitigation: representative segmented cohort, concurrent control, one isolated change, delayed window, confidence/power plan, pause inconclusive, error-budget freeze

security_and_failure_modes.attack_or_fault: schema/external side effect is irreversible or previous bundle is incompatible; rollback job fails
security_and_failure_modes.mitigation: expand-and-contract compatibility, compensation plan, preflight/drilled restore, last-known-good artifact, automatic abort only for proven reversible class, incident escalation on failure

security_and_failure_modes.attack_or_fault: human/bot changes remote field/options while stale reconciler overwrites; webhook lost/duplicated
security_and_failure_modes.mitigation: managed-field ownership, logical-key resolution, plan/re-read/verify, per-project lease, idempotency, scheduled scan, report-only destructive/ambiguous drift; never treat YAML as observed truth

security_and_failure_modes.attack_or_fault: agent closes more issues or cuts cost while defects, review load or user harm rise
security_and_failure_modes.mitigation: hard safety invariants and multi-dimensional SPACE/SLO/DORA-style outcomes; raw denominators; no single composite promotion target

security_and_failure_modes.attack_or_fault: GitHub/API/eval model/metrics unavailable, rate-limited or changes behavior
security_and_failure_modes.mitigation: bounded retries with jitter, durable queue, circuit breaker, stale-evidence expiry, freeze promotion fail-closed, preserve current release and manual runbook

premerge: JSON/YAML schema validation and golden fixtures for every contract/version migration
state-machine property tests: only allowed transitions; duplicates/out-of-order events and retry after crash are idempotent
OPA/promotion policy unit/coverage and mutation tests, including missing/stale/conflicting evidence→deny/pause
permission negative tests proving proposer cannot read secrets/holdouts, write protected paths/Project policy, approve environment, bypass ruleset or delete audit
workflow static checks for explicit permissions, full-SHA pins, untrusted expression/shell injection and workflow_run privilege crossover
reconciler contract tests against recorded GraphQL responses: ID churn, pagination, renamed/deleted option, rate limit, concurrent human edit, webhook duplicate/loss and dry-run no mutation
eval harness hermeticity, frozen seed/tool mocks where possible, repeatability budget, oracle audit, contamination/dedup and adversarial/metamorphic/AgentDojo-style cases
artifact/attestation negative tests: wrong repo/run/SHA/digest, unsigned, oversized, path traversal and malformed bundle all rejected
preproduction: shadow test asserts zero real side effects and alerts on any attempted write
canary simulator tests success/fail/inconclusive branches, representative routing, budget limits and concurrent-control labels
rollback drill restores exact compatible digest and verifies service/agent SLO plus Project/release registry; chaos test unavailable metrics/API and partial rollback
validation_and_tests.acceptance: No critical unauthorized action; all required deterministic regressions pass; statistical/non-inferiority and cost/latency thresholds are declared before results; independent reviewer binds evidence to exact digests; shadow passes; canary and rollback drill pass. Missing or inconclusive evidence pauses.
postrelease: random human audit stratified by risk and disagreement
monthly recurrence, escape, drift, grader agreement, dataset freshness, false promotion/rollback and exception-expiry review

cadence: continuous: durable event intake, SLO/security alerts, canary abort and webhook processing
daily: scheduled Project/rules/environment drift scan, failed queue/retry/dead-letter review, stale lease cleanup
weekly: new eval triage, action-item aging, dataset leakage/privacy checks, candidate cost and false-decision review
monthly: policy/evaluator calibration, Project schema drift, access/token inventory, sampled promotion audit, exception expiry and rollback drill status
quarterly: threat model, dependency/action pin upgrades, disaster restore, holdout refresh/time split, autonomy tier and build-vs-buy review
operational_maintenance.recovery: Freeze new promotions but keep current known-good on evidence/policy/metrics outage. Retry only idempotent operations. Restore registry/audit/evidence from tested backups; rotate compromised GitHub App/environment credentials; reconcile remote actual state; open incident/postmortem/eval before re-enable.
operational_maintenance.cleanup: Expire raw telemetry by policy; propagate lawful deletion through derived objects while retaining non-sensitive audit tombstone; remove orphan shadow resources, branches/worktrees and artifacts; archive—not silently erase—failed evals/releases; retire stale cases only through reviewed manifest change.
operational_maintenance.upgrade: Renovate/dependency PR proposes pinned action/tool/schema updates; replay fixed+fresh evals, shadow and canary like any control change. Model aliases are forbidden for promotion unless resolved to immutable provider version and separately evaluated.
runbooks: GitHub Actions credential or artifact compromise
privacy deletion and evidence legal hold
break-glass with expiry and post-incident backfill

production_ready: Git PR/CODEOWNERS/ruleset review when correctly enforced
deterministic tests, signed artifacts, bounded canary and tested rollback
conditional: LLM/trajectory graders after domain expert calibration
automatic low-risk promotion after sustained repository-specific evidence
Project desired-state reconciliation because APIs, IDs, plans, races and human edits require careful ownership
telemetry-to-eval automation because privacy, provenance, oracle and selection bias need curation
experimental: agent-generated metamorphic cases and judge ensembles
cross-provider stable agent telemetry and outcome schemas
unsupported: proposer access to hidden eval answers or release credentials
automatic high-impact or irreversible production repair
key_uncertainties: offline-to-production validity for long stateful trajectories
sample size/window for rare delayed harms
stable immutable model/version semantics across vendors
GitHub plan-specific enforcement and Project API behavior in the target organization
maturity_and_uncertainty.overall: High confidence in separation, versioning, reconciliation and progressive-delivery mechanics; medium in agent-eval practice; low that any general unattended self-improving repository is safe or economically proven.

implementation_recommendation.core_decision: Build a governed proposal/eval/promotion loop, not a self-owning agent. Git is the desired policy/configuration ledger; GitHub Projects and deployment settings are remote actual state reconciled and audited by narrow independent controllers.
mvp_0_4_weeks: Add schemas, component/version envelope, CODEOWNERS/ruleset protection, explicit Actions permissions and full-SHA pins.
Instrument trace/change/version IDs and a restricted redacted evidence store. Baseline outcomes, review cost and current error/rollback rates.
Implement read-only Project GraphQL inventory and dry-run drift report; do not mutate until ownership mappings and negative tests pass.
Start human-reviewed postmortem→regression-case curation. Agents may draft cases/proposals only.
stage_2_4_8_weeks: Add portable hermetic offline runner, deterministic invariants, repeated trials, private temporal holdout, expert calibration and attested evidence bundle.
Use separate GitHub App identities for proposer, Project reconciler and evaluator. Reconciler mutates only allowlisted managed fields and verifies by re-read.
Deploy non-authoritative shadow with side-effect sinks; retain all promotion decisions as PR/check artifacts.
stage_3_after_evidence: Canary only reversible low-risk prompt/router/tool/workflow bundles with exact digest, protected environment, budgets, concurrent control, abort and drilled rollback.

Allow auto-promotion only for narrow proven classes after predeclared local thresholds, sufficient denominators, zero critical unauthorized actions and sampled human audit. Never auto-promote control-plane changes.
do_not_build_first: write-capable Project reconciliation without dry-run/ownership model
implementation_recommendation.exit_criteria: Expand authority only if retained improvements beat baseline on user/SLO/stability and net cost, false promotion/rollback is understood, evaluator agreement is acceptable by slice, rollback drills succeed, and no critical unauthorized action occurs. Otherwise keep proposal-first or retire the loop.

conflicts.topic: Git declarations versus GitHub operational state
conflicts.claims: Repository YAML is reviewable and reproducible, but Projects fields/items, rulesets and environment approvals are remote resources changed by API/UI (https://docs.github.com/en/issues/planning-and-tracking-with-projects/automating-your-project/using-the-api-to-manage-projects; https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/rules).
conflicts.resolution: Name YAML desired state only. Read remote actual, plan/apply/re-read with managed-field ownership; surface conflicts/destructive drift rather than overwrite.

conflicts.topic: continuous automated eval versus trustworthy ground truth
conflicts.claims: OpenAI/Anthropic advocate continuous automation and graders (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/evaluation-best-practices; https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/demystifying-evals-for-ai-agents), while SWE-Bench+ finds leakage and weak-test passes (https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.06992).
conflicts.resolution: Automate replay, not authority: private temporal holdouts, deterministic invariants, expert calibration, proposer/evaluator separation and suspicious-pass audit.

conflicts.topic: environment approval versus strong multi-party separation
conflicts.claims: GitHub can prevent self-review, but one approval from a list of up to six reviewers is sufficient and features vary by plan (https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/deployments-and-environments).
conflicts.resolution: Use environment approval for exact-digest gating, but add external/two-person policy for sensitive releases and test target-plan behavior.

conflicts.topic: privileged workflow chaining versus untrusted evaluation
conflicts.claims: workflow_run enables a privileged follow-on even if the triggering workflow was unprivileged (https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/events-that-trigger-workflows#workflow_run); Security Lab shows artifact/cache/code abuse patterns (https://securitylab.github.com/resources/github-actions-preventing-pwn-requests/).
conflicts.resolution: Privilege stage validates metadata/attestation and never executes candidate-controlled content; promotion consumes a small declarative evidence bundle only.

conflicts.topic: agent productivity optimism versus measured outcome
conflicts.claims: Benchmark/vendor narratives suggest faster work, but METR’s scoped RCT found experienced developers 19% slower despite optimistic forecasts/perceptions (https://metr.org/blog/2025-07-10-early-2025-ai-experienced-os-dev-study/).
conflicts.resolution: No universal claim: run repository-specific baseline, shadow and retained-outcome experiment including review/on-call cost.

conflicts.claims: Argo can abort/rollback a rollout from analysis (https://argo-rollouts.readthedocs.io/en/stable/features/analysis/), but external side effects and schema/data changes may not reverse.
conflicts.resolution: Auto-rollback only proven compatible immutable bundles or reversible flags; destructive changes need compensation and human approval.

conflicts.topic: blameless root cause versus systems causality
conflicts.claims: SRE postmortems include root causes (https://sre.google/sre-book/postmortem-culture/), while Cook warns complex accidents lack one isolated cause (https://how.complexsystems.fail/).
conflicts.resolution: Record trigger, contributors, conditions and failed defenses; avoid automated single-cause attribution.

confidence.overall: High for GitHub/API/security contracts and mature SRE/progressive-delivery mechanics; medium for agent-specific evaluation design; low for unattended improvement, universal thresholds or net economic benefit.
high: GitHub Project state is remote and mutation-driven, so declarative Git needs reconciliation
identity separation, immutable digests, idempotency and rollback rehearsal are necessary controls
medium: trajectory graders plus expert calibration predict repository outcomes
automatic promotion of narrow reversible low-risk control bundles after local evidence
Project reconciliation can safely coexist with manual edits under explicit field ownership
low: benchmark score predicts production user value
a universal canary sample/window or automation threshold
future GitHub plan/API/model-provider behavior after the as-of date
